text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Are you reeeally gonna be alright? You've always had a habit of being a bit of a goof right when it matters most..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Geez, I know already!
I've grown too, you know!"

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
""! ...Hehe, that's true.
You're not a little kid forever...
You've grown into a wonderful young Umamusume now, after all.""

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Mom...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, yeah! Just watch!
I'm gonna keep showing you some wickedly awesome running!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...And so! Please drill me mercilessly
so I can win when it matters most!
choice_data_list: Got it! Let's do our best!

text_block_list.text:
Hold on a seconnnnnd
with that training, PLEEAAASE!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: E-El-chan!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: El will become... the strongest in the world!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
For that sake—I must defeat Spe-chan,
who taught me the bitter taste of defeat!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"...And so!
El will gladly be your training partner!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
There's no point in beating a Spe-chan
who's weak and powerless~.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"...So, for El's sake as well,
I figured I should help you get even stronger!"
Ailes♪ Stealing a march on us is not allowed, you know?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You aren't the only one
who's hoping for a rematch with Spe-chan, you know.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...Spe-chan, Trainer.
Would it be alright if I joined you?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It is only by overcoming the best Umamusume in Japan
that one's military glory is truly established, after all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, look at everyone gathered here~.
Ah, don't mind me, please keep chatting.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Besides, it feels like I'd gain more just listening from the sidelines♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: (Thanks to everyone, I was able to become strong...)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: (Because everyone was there, I was able to move forward...)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(Because everyone is here with me...
I know we'll keep going, on and on――)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Let's run, all together!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep running with everyone forever and ever...
I'm sure that—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Because she's the "Number One Umamusume in Japan"...
who I admired, ran after, and finally found!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... In other words, you have no intention of losing either?
What a wonderful declaration of war.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well now, they really took me lightly, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufufufu... Bring it on-deeees!
We'll show you El and the team's true power, leagues beyond what it was back then!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I'm counting on you!

"And so, Special Week
and her rivals dashed off
toward the training course."
